2027 में मकर राशि के लिए दो बड़े गोचर सब: In 2027, two big transits matter most for Capricorn — Jupiter and Saturn. From January to June, Jupiter in the 7th house is very favourable for marriage, partnership and business — chances of a match for the unmarried, sweetness in marriage and new contracts for the married. From 26 June to 26 November, Jupiter in the 8th house brings obstacles, sudden expenses and health worries — put off big risks, new loans and hasty investments; research, spirituality and insurance work go well. From 26 November, Jupiter moves into Virgo, the 9th house from your sign.
3 जून तक और फिर 20 अक्टूबर से शनि तीसरे: Until 3 June and again from 20 October, Saturn is very favourable in the 3rd house — courage grows, effort pays off fully, opponents weaken and stalled work moves forward. From 3 June to 20 October, Saturn in Aries, the 4th house (Dhaiya), puts pressure on home, family and mind — a house move, delays in property matters or worry about your mother’s health are possible.
